name: Mobile App Development Services
description: Professional mobile application development services for iOS and Android using Flutter, React Native, and native technologies. We build fast, scalable, and user-focused mobile applications for businesses and startups.

android.name: Android App Development
android.description: Modern Android application development using Kotlin, Java, and Flutter. High-performance, secure, and optimized apps for all Android devices.

ios.name: iOS App Development
ios.description: Professional iOS application development using Swift, SwiftUI, and Flutter. Beautiful, high-performance apps built to meet App Store standards.

crossPlatform.name: Cross-Platform App Development
crossPlatform.description: Build Android and iOS applications from a single codebase using Flutter and React Native, reducing development time and costs.

uiux.name: Mobile UI/UX Design
uiux.description: Design intuitive, engaging, and user-friendly mobile interfaces that deliver exceptional user experiences across all devices.

maintenance.name: App Maintenance & Support
maintenance.description: Ongoing maintenance, bug fixes, feature enhancements, performance optimization, and technical support to keep your mobile app running smoothly.

publishing.name: App Store Deployment
publishing.description: Publish and deploy your applications to the Google Play Store and Apple App Store, including submission, review assistance, and updates.
